item.title: Watchdog group says CFTC told prediction markets to defy court orders on geofencing, NJToday reports
item.description: - **Watchdog group says CFTC told prediction markets to defy court orders on geofencing, NJToday reports** — Better Markets on November 6 accused the CFTC of directing platforms to explain within 30 days why they cannot serve all 50 states and threatening enforcement against firms that comply with court-ordered geofencing. The group cited CFTC press release 9323-26 and a recent New York appeals ruling that could lead to geofencing in New York and Connecticut. (NJToday)

item.title: ESPN adds prediction markets to on-air talent guidelines on insider betting, Awful Announcing reports
item.description: - **ESPN adds prediction markets to on-air talent guidelines on insider betting, Awful Announcing reports** — ESPN talent department circulated a memo before the midterms barring on-air talent from betting on sports news where they have inside information, including on prediction markets, Front Office Sports reported. item.title: Non-trading spectators outnumber active participants five to one on Kalshi during the midterms, GazeWire reports
item.description: - **Non-trading spectators outnumber active participants five to one on Kalshi during the midterms, GazeWire reports** — CryptoSlate data cited by GazeWire shows millions watched Kalshi congressional race odds, control gauges and maps without opening accounts or placing trades during recent midterm cycles. Kalshi reported 2.5 billion dollars in midterm trading volume, up from 1.3 billion dollars in the 2024 election cycle. (GazeWire)
